parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const metrics=r.metrics||r.input?.metrics||{};const rules=r.rules||r.input?.rules||[];if(!Array.isArray(rules)||!rules.length) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-X',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'NO_THRESHOLD_RULES',message:'rules[] is required.'},next_action:'configure_thresholds'}}];const cmp=(v,op,t)=>op==='gt'?v>t:op==='gte'?v>=t:op==='lt'?v<t:op==='lte'?v<=t:op==='eq'?v===t:false;const alerts=[];for(const rule of rules){const value=Number(metrics[rule.metric]);const threshold=Number(rule.threshold);if(Number.isFinite(value)&&Number.isFinite(threshold)&&cmp(value,rule.operator||'gt',threshold)) alerts.push({metric:rule.metric,value,operator:rule.operator||'gt',threshold,severity:rule.severity||'warning',message:rule.message||`${rule.metric} crossed threshold`});}return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C5-X',component_version:'v1',monitoring:{alerts,alert_count:alerts.length,status:alerts.some(a=>a.severity==='critical')?'critical':alerts.length?'alert':'normal'},next_action:alerts.length?'notify_threshold_alerts':'no_alert',error:null}}];
